takeaway: Vomiting in pyloric stenosis loses H⁺ and Cl⁻: hypochloraemic metabolic alkalosis. To keep sodium and volume, the kidney swaps Na⁺ for H⁺ and K⁺, so K⁺ falls and the urine is paradoxically acidic.
